name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 4.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2026-06-04, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
